What the shop does

Haircuts and fades

Scissor cuts, fades and shape ups. Customers write that the barber suggests what suits them best and that it takes less time than elsewhere.

Hot towel shave

One customer calls the hot towel shave the best one in town, another left as smooth as he was hoping.

Beards and shaves

Beard maintenance and conditioning, straight razor shave and head shave, as customers list on Google.

Kids’ cuts

Parents bring their sons along. One mother writes the cut was quick, stress free and a great job.

Inside the shop

Photos from the shop’s Google listing.

A shop full of classics

What customers notice on Google.

Something to look at

Classics and antiques you will enjoy looking at while you wait, as one customer puts it.

A red Mini and old bikes

A red Mini with a LARNACUTS number plate, classic motorbikes and a chequered floor. One customer writes the barber restores bikes too.

English spoken

Customers from abroad write that English is spoken and communication is easy.

In Larnaca since 2013

LarnaCuts opened in September 2013. Some customers have been coming for ten years and more, and one describes the barber as London qualified. The shop is known for its vintage decor, and six reviews single out that you can simply walk in without an appointment.

What customers say

Two of 230 Google reviews, 5.0 stars on average.

“I been visiting Larnacuts Barber shop for nearly 10 years now and the place is excellent in every way. Top quality haircuts from an experienced London qualified barber very professional and mostly a very clean environment. I also recommend the hot towel shave as its the best one in town for sure! And as for the barber shop its self a stunning warm little barbers full of classics and antiques that you will enjoy looking at whilst waiting around. No appointments needed just walk in and wait for your turn just like it should be. Well done Andreas”
Andreas Andreou · Google review
“Always on point! Very clean barber shop and very good prices! No appointment needed you just walk in. Andreas is a master at what he does. English spoken too and makes it easy to communicate! The best by far”
Kosmas Kosma · Google review
